settings.title: Settings
settings.webhook_hint: Get notified when jobs complete or tasks fail
settings.hpc_preset_loaded: Loaded "{name}" preset — edit, then Save to persist
settings.hpc_regex_hint: Extracts the cluster job ID from the submit command's output — exactly one capture group. e.g. sbatch prints "Submitted batch job 12345" → Submitted batch job ([0-9]+)
settings.hpc_f_submit_hint: Shell command that queues ONE task on the cluster (your qsub/sbatch line). runq runs it once per task.
settings.hpc_f_status_hint: Command that asks the scheduler about a task. Leave empty to rely on status.json written by the task itself.
settings.hpc_f_kill_hint: Shell command that cancels a queued/running task.
settings.hpc_f_parser_hint: Pipeline that turns the raw probe output into one status word: pending / running / success / failed / killed / gone. Each line is one stage; the previous stage's output is piped into the next via stdin.
settings.hpc_rewrite_note: Saving rewrites the hpc: section of config.yaml (file comments are not preserved).
settings.conflict_body: config.yaml was modified by someone else (an editor, the CLI, another client) after this form was loaded. Pick which version wins — nothing has been overwritten yet.
settings.conflict_no_overlap: The changed parts of the file don't overlap the fields you're editing — keeping your edits is safe.
settings.unsaved_leave_confirm: You have unsaved config changes. Leave and discard them?
settings.config_changed_on_disk: config.yaml changed on disk — your unsaved edits are kept; saving will show a comparison
settings.restart_hint: Takes effect after restarting the dashboard / daemon
settings.anime_hint: Show chibi mascot at various spots
